title: `(x % k + k) % k` is the floor remainder of BIGINTs
description: `%` of BIGINTs truncates, so the writer's `date_bin` takes `((u - o) % k + k) % k` (sql/core/temporal.py): for o = 3 and k = 10, `u - that` gives −7, −7, 3, −7 for u = −1, −7, 7, 0, and −9223372036854775807 for u = MIN + 3, without overflow.
reference: `Time.bucket k o u = floorTo k (u - o) + o`.

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_spark`'s `_writer_probes`, run locally with ANSI on and off, on the folded and the codegen path, which agree on each. pyspark 4.3.0, Java 21.0.13, macOS arm64, session time zone UTC (BASE_CONF); probes.json's header records the earlier homelab run.
